name: expense-api

dependencies.name: aws-s3

config.description: AWS access key with put/get object permission on the receipts bucket
AWS secret key matching the access key
AWS region the bucket lives in
Bucket used to store expense claim receipt files

dependencies.description: Stores receipt attachments; the API generates short-lived presigned PutObject/GetObject URLs so the browser uploads and downloads receipts directly without ever holding AWS credentials.

description: Owns expense claim data end to end: submission, manager approval/rejection, resubmission, and finance's CSV export to payroll. Tracks each employee's designated manager for routing approvals, and issues presigned receipt-storage URLs rather than proxying file bytes. Does not send notifications and does not integrate with a live payroll API.
